user.title: Sony STR-DA ES receiver
user.description: Enter the address of the receiver. On the receiver, set Settings > Network > External Control to ON first.

data_description.port: 6001 for receivers from before 2012 (such as the STR-DA3600ES), 33335 for newer ones.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the receiver on that address and port.
error.external_control_disabled: The receiver refuses commands. Set Settings > Network > External Control to ON on the receiver.

data.max_db: Volume at 100% of the slider (never exceeded)

data_description.sources: One per line as Name=Code, with the code in hexadecimal, for example HDMI 1=1A. Select the input on the receiver and read its code from the input_code attribute of the media player.

error.invalid_sources: Use one Name=Code per line, with the code in hexadecimal (00-FF).
error.invalid_range: The volume at 0% must be lower than at 100%.
